cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll introduce you to the curator if you hang my exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hang it Saturday. Can you send her portfolio requirements now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Of course. Could you collect my frames too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Give me her email; I'll ask her directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct access includes taking the show down. Shall I put you down for Sunday?

mechanism: A professionally distinguishes introduction, requirements and direct contact as separate access services, each demanding more exhibition labour.
confusable: D46 generally exchanges favours; D70 charges specifically for successive pieces of access and information.
comparison: Storeroom alternative prices physical access and key custody; curator alternative prices gatekept contact and submission information.
seedUse: Curator introduction, Saturday hanging, frame collection and Sunday takedown derive from D70-b; S03 adds exact scope correction.
